remarks: Live in the most adorable and quiet cul-de-sac, yet still be minutes from both the Merritt and downtown Stamford. Totally renovated in 2017, this home in the Mid Ridges has everything you need in a 3 bedroom home - updated kitchen and baths, beautiful hardwood floors, tons of natural light and an open floor plan. Head outside and it gets even better. The fully fenced-in, flat backyard with patio is perfect for entertaining, enjoying the ambiance of the quiet neighborhood, or watching your pets play safely. Central air, a tankless hot water heater, natural gas and the washer and dryer make this house incredibly comfortable for every lifestyle. Available the first week of September.
